physical: A measurement yields one of the observable's eigenvalues, and afterwards the system is in the corresponding eigenstate; which value appears is not determined by the prior state.
reflected_sentence: This keeps: a reading yields one allowed value and the outcome then matches that value, and the prior strength does not fix which value appears.
rule_reason: statistical form, empty cost block, no resistance-carrying quantity and no separation
interpretation: This keeps. It is not realization. It is not Desire or Intuition.
closing: The rule decided on its own. Statistical form, empty costs, no resistance and no separation, so the shape keeps. The yielded value and the prior strength have no partners. I described them in plain words and did not borrow realization. No judgment call on the shape.
